label: Workshop 5
title: PersonaDesk Portal
summary: Give each persona a personalised, read-only Workbench beside Hermes WebUI's chat: work queue, drafts awaiting review and their evidence, laid out per persona and served by a single-persona sidecar behind WebUI's token-checked proxy.
hardware: CPU is enough for what is built so far

prompts.label: Why a sidecar?
prompts.prompt: Workshop 5 serves the Workbench data from a loopback sidecar behind Hermes WebUI's proxy instead of from the extension itself. Explain why, and what the token-v1 header and proxy consent protect against.
